method: Internal AI bilingual reading of every final fresh target across six explicit dimensions. Structural/inference success is not semantic approval. No human or independent reviewer approval. No product changes after this review.

rows.source: Every convergent sequence is bounded, but boundedness alone does not guarantee convergence. The order of the implication matters.
rows.actualTarget: Setiap konvergen barisan adalah terbatas, tetapi terikat saja tidak menjamin kekonvergenan. Urutan masalah implikasi.
rows.reason: Boundedness becomes terikat and the assertion that implication order matters becomes Urutan masalah implikasi; the logical explanation is not preserved.

rows.source: The sample was weighed before the solvent was added. The reported mass therefore excludes the solvent rather than describing the final mixture.
rows.actualTarget: The sample was weighed before the solvent was added. The reported mass therefore excludes the solvent rather than describing the final mixture.
rows.reason: Safe rejection preserves the source, but no accepted translation exists. It is not a semantic pass.

rows.source: The odds ratio is not the same as the risk ratio. They can differ substantially when the event is common.
rows.actualTarget: Rasio peluang tidak sama dengan rasio risiko. Mereka bisa sangat berbeda jika peristiwa itu umum.
rows.reason: Odds/risk distinction and common-event qualification survive; Mereka is awkward for ratios.

rows.source: A fall in marginal cost does not necessarily lower average cost immediately. The current production level matters for that comparison.
rows.actualTarget: Jatuhnya biaya marjinal tidak selalu dengan biaya rata-rata lebih rendah. Tingkat produksi saat ini penting untuk perbandingan itu.
rows.reason: The cost-lowering predicate is malformed and immediately is omitted, losing a time qualification essential to the economic claim.

rows.source: The instrument could distinguish the two signals only after averaging repeated measurements. This does not mean that either signal became stronger.
rows.actualTarget: Alat ini dapat membedakan kedua sinyal itu hanya setelah berulang kali pengukuran. Ini tidak berarti bahwa baik sinyal menjadi lebih kuat.
rows.reason: Averaging repeated measurements becomes only repeated measurements. The enabling operation is omitted.

rows.source: The committee postponed its decision because the evidence was incomplete. Postponement should not be interpreted as rejection of the hypothesis.
rows.actualTarget: Komite menunda keputusannya karena bukti tidak lengkap. Penonton hendaknya tidak ditafsirkan sebagai penolakan hipotesis.
rows.reason: Postponement becomes Penonton (audience), changing the subject of the second proposition.

rows.source: Nilai mutlak selisih kedua perkiraan lebih kecil dari 0.02. Pernyataan ini tidak menentukan perkiraan mana yang lebih besar.
rows.actualTarget: Absolute value second difference is less than 0.02. This statement does not determine which estimates are greater.
rows.reason: Difference of the two estimates becomes second difference with no estimate referent in the first sentence. The quantity bounded by 0.02 changes.

rows.source: Zat padat itu larut tanpa bereaksi dengan pelarut. Hilangnya bentuk padat tidak membuktikan terjadinya reaksi kimia.
rows.actualTarget: The solid matter dissolves without reacting with the solvent. Loss of solid form does not prove chemical reaction.
rows.reason: Dissolution without reaction and the limit on inference from loss of solid form remain. No critical change identified in this internal review.

rows.source: Sampel yang lebih besar memperkecil galat acak tetapi tidak otomatis menghapus bias seleksi. Kedua sumber kesalahan perlu dibedakan.
rows.actualTarget: Larger Sample shrinks random errors but does not automatically remove bias selection. Both sources of error need to be distinguished.
rows.reason: Random error and selection-bias distinction remain, with awkward word order and capitalization.

rows.source: Kenaikan pendapatan nominal belum tentu meningkatkan daya beli. Harga barang yang dibeli rumah tangga juga perlu diperhitungkan.
rows.actualTarget: The nominal income increase is not necessarily increasing purchasing power. Price goods purchased households also need to be calculated.
rows.reason: Main nominal-income/purchasing-power relationship survives; the household-price clause is grammatically poor and calculated is weaker than taken into account.

rows.source: Pengamat tidak mengetahui kelompok perlakuan peserta saat menilai hasil. Penyembunyian informasi itu bertujuan mengurangi bias penilaian.
rows.actualTarget: The observers don't know the group of participants when assessing results. The cover - up of information is intended to reduce bias.
rows.reason: Treatment assignment disappears from group of participants; assessment bias becomes generic bias and concealment is rendered as cover-up.

rows.source: Asumsi independensi digunakan dalam penurunan rumus. Jika pengamatan saling bergantung, rumus tersebut memerlukan pembenaran tambahan.
rows.actualTarget: Assumed independence used in derivation formula. If observations depend on one another, they require additional justification.
rows.reason: The final they refers to observations instead of the formula, moving the requirement for additional justification.
